title: Warning pictogram: not suitable for children under 36 months
source: Directive 2009/48/EC on the safety of toys, Annex V, Part B, point 1 (OJ L 170, 30.6.2009), https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:32009L0048
use: The directive's own graphic, taken from the EUR-Lex page, unchanged except that the table border of the page (a line along the bottom and right edge) is cropped away; the directive requires it to be accompanied by a brief indication of the specific hazard (on the sheet: a child must not swallow a magnet or other small parts).
